method.contextPolicy: A new Chromium browser context is created for each sample; HTTP cache is isolated per context. OS, host and upstream caches are not cleared.
method.readinessDefinition: Elapsed page navigation time until the map status announces 4,218 sources after MapLibre becomes usable.
method.transferBytesDefinition: Chromium CDP encoded response body bytes received before sampling ended; excludes request/response headers and does not represent every byte on the wire.
method.decodedBytesDefinition: Sum of decodedBodySize values exposed by PerformanceResourceTiming; cross-origin entries can be unavailable.
method.longTaskWindow: Observed from document initialization through one second after map readiness.
method.webglRendererPolicy: Chromium is forced to SwiftShader for a repeatable software-renderer baseline.
method.browserModePolicy: Chromium runs with the host display enabled; this mode can be used for a paired hardware/software renderer comparison on the same display path.
method.externalFallback: One additional desktop context blocks all non-loopback HTTP(S) requests before navigation.
